Interiar

Sector Interior design
Duration Seven days

Interiar is an interior design studio creating considered, liveable spaces for homes and workplaces. Their portfolio was strong, but without a website to show it off, new clients had no easy way to see the quality of their work.

Project overview

We let the interiors do the talking. Large, calm photography leads every page, projects are presented as a gallery to browse, and a simple enquiry form sits at the end of each one.
